essence: The ritual procedure under discussion does not include gem arrangement for a golden image.
Honey and clarified butter together with gold should be placed in a vessel using the heart mantra.
After purifying the image and the city and so forth, one should perform circumambulation.
One should construct the worship pavilion in front of the shrine and at its sides.
Twice-born officiants may make the pavilion in nine, five, or one divisions, either round or square.
